description:
Birthday reminders that text people for you, by SMS, Signal or WhatsApp Wishday remembers birthdays and helps you send the message.
  • Import birthdays from your contacts or a Birday backup, or add them by hand
  • Auto SMS: Wishday texts them at the time you choose, and retries if it fails
  • Signal, Molly or WhatsApp: a notification opens the chat with your message ready, so you just tap send
  • Star important people and get an early gift reminder, with your gift ideas
  • Stats: birthdays by month, big birthdays coming up, birthday twins and star signs
  • Match people to your contacts and save their birthdays into your contacts
  • Message templates with {name}, {fullname} and {age}
  • Color themes, light and dark mode, in English and Spanish
  • No internet permission, no tracking; everything stays on your phone
